record.body:
## Description

R7: Overview, Spec, Design, Decisions, Evidence, Tasks, and Proof keep distinct roles, but each tab's body uses structured UI blocks (cards, strips, lists, or matrices) rather than bare prose-only dumps.
R9: Tab-specific content remains reachable under the shared chrome (e.g. Spec/Design prose in readable sections; Tasks as a structured list; Evidence/Proof as structured blocks).

## Approach

Extend detailView / App so each phase tab body is structured: Overview highlights; Spec/Design/Decisions wrap markdown in titled sections/cards; Tasks as a list with status; Evidence/Proof as structured blocks. Do not change home/main layout. Tests assert non-Overview tabs are not sole raw dumps and content remains under chrome.

payload.title: Structured UI for each phase tab body
